informationsErreur.libelleErreur: Impossible de fermer l'enveloppe. Code erreur UCENV_CTR_RG01: Si le sens de l'enveloppe vaut « Import » et que le type du camion vaut « Plein », alors au moins une ENS et au moins une formalité de dédouanement doivent être renseignées.

comment: The refusal path, so the worker's dead-letter behaviour can be exercised without
waiting for real French customs to object to something.
Lower priority number wins in WireMock, so this is 1 against the happy path's 5:
the narrower matcher has to be preferred, or the 200 would always answer first.
Triggered by putting REFUSE-ME in identifiantsDeclaration. Since ICS2 landed that is no
longer a setting: record REFUSE-ME as the manifest's declaration and approve it. The MRN
validator refuses that shape over HTTP, so drop it straight on the queue instead —
`az storage message put --queue-name elo-envelopes` with declarationIdentifiers set to
["REFUSE-ME"], as iac/README.md shows. That is the point: the only way to reach this
path now is to bypass the API, because ApproveManifestHandler refuses a manifest with no
declaration and the validator refuses one that is not shaped like an MRN.
The message should land in elo-envelopes-poison, and the worker's log
should name the 400 and FONC-ERR-004 and nothing from libelleErreur — the label
quotes the declaration it objected to, which is why it is not logged.
The body is the real thing from the service contract 3.1.3.3, French and all: a
stub that answered in English would not prove the code avoids logging it.
